summary: Five unique executed retail leases in Phoenix within 8 miles and dated 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 qualify and fill the shortlist, ranked by distance ascending: R1695 (0.80 mi, 11.28 $/sf/yr effective net), R3353 (1.03 mi, 16.93), R2434 (1.26 mi, 19.41), R1930 (1.49 mi, 9.47) and R6289 (1.72 mi, 22.12). Two further records (R8772 at 1.95 mi, 23.69; R5747 at 2.18 mi, 12.77) are eligible but fall outside the five slots. Controlling updates: U-R3353-1 (executed amendment, effective 2026-08-20) raised free rent to 4 months and TI to 18 $/sf for R3353; U-R2434-2 (2026-09-10) and U-R1930-3 (unsigned draft) were not applied. R2614 is a duplicate of entity BIRCH-REN-46690 already represented by R1695. Effective net rents span 9.47 to 22.12 $/sf/yr, driven mainly by gross-lease expense loads, free rent and TI rather than face rent (21.00-24.20 $/sf/yr face). Comp grid delivered as artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx with live Excel formulas.
limitations: The effective net rent convention is undiscounted and rent-only (no time value, no percentage rent, no operating-expense reimbursement modeling); it is not a market appraisal or value opinion.

NNN comps assume a zero expense deduction per the client convention, so gross comps (R1695, R1930) show structurally lower effective net rents and are not directly comparable to NNN comps without adjustment.
annual_expenses_psf is unknown for all NNN records; no landlord expense leakage is captured.

R2434's face rent may drop to 2.00 (unit basis unstated in the change) under U-R2434-2, but that amendment is published/effective after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and was excluded; the shortlisted figure could change post-cutoff.
R1930's free rent could rise to 8 months if the U-R1930-3 draft is executed, which would materially lower its effective net rent.
Distances are taken as supplied (miles from an unspecified subject point) and were not independently verified; no address, tenant, size-band or credit adjustments were made.
R2614/R1695 duplication was inferred from the identical entity_id and terms; if they were separate leases at the same entity, one comp slot would change.
Missing fields were treated as unknown, not zero, causing exclusions (R3442, R5629, R1009, R5471, R7377) that may reflect data gaps rather than genuinely unattractive terms.
Lease commencement dates, rent-step timing beyond the stated month-13/25 convention, and whether TI was actually funded are unverified in the extracts.
